scope: train-only CPU; no validation, test, GPU, source identity feature, or fixed numeric keep threshold

calibration.inner_predictions: for each held fit family Fi, ensemble three models each trained on two of the other three fit families
calibration.threshold: minimum genuinely held ensemble probability among essential target-support components
calibration.essential: component is the sole retained component supporting at least one detected target-id/50-bin group

outer_prediction: ensemble four models, each trained on F1..F4 except one family; none sees F5
selection: family and mean/min aggregation selected only by inner grouped official Score subject to every-inner Score/IoU/Pd/CO/TP non-decrease and Fa non-increase
success: selected nonidentity outer F5 has CO/Pd/TP non-decrease and deletes FP and false components
